module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: When emergency lights appear behind the vehicle, the driver and passengers are advised to remain calm and cooperate. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: Signal and move off the road or to its side at the first safe opportunity when being stopped. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: During the stop, switch off the engine and audio equipment. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: Remain inside the vehicle unless the officer directs you to get out. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility

module_quizzes.title: Keep your hands on the wheel or another place where the officer can readily see them. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: Follow the instructions the officer gives to you and your passengers. practice

module_quizzes.title: An officer conducting a stop may approach the vehicle from either side. practice

module_quizzes.title: Lower the window on the approaching officer's side to make conversation easier. practice

module_quizzes.title: Tell the officer at the first contact if there is a weapon in the vehicle. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: Wait for directions before reaching for a license or vehicle paperwork. practice

module_quizzes.title: A nonuniformed officer will ordinarily show credentials; you may ask to see credentials if none are shown. practice

module_quizzes.title: The officer ordinarily explains the stop and may ask about the trip. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: When instructed to exit, keep your hands visible and stand where the officer directs. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility
module_quizzes.title: Ask respectfully when you need an officer to clarify an instruction or action. practice
